goal: Actually run aspire agent init against this repo, find out what it really does, and correct pmcro-aspire (built from documentation alone in the previous cycle) to match reality.

steps.action: Install the Aspire CLI (it was registered but broken -- dotnet tool install reported already-installed but the exe did not exist; fixed via uninstall/reinstall) and run aspire agent init --non-interactive from the repo root.

Determine what aspire agent init actually did: check git status for new files, check whether an MCP server was registered (claude mcp list), and read the installed skill files to find the real integration mechanism.
Exercise the real mechanism live: aspire start, aspire wait, aspire ps --format Json, aspire describe --format Json, GET /api/chat, aspire stop -- record actual results.
Correct plugins/pmcro-aspire to match what was actually observed rather than leave the MCP-server-based v0.1.0 content standing as inaccurate governance evidence.
Validate all touched JSON, commit the corrected skill plus the newly-installed .agents/skills/aspire* files (needed for the skill's own references to resolve on a fresh clone), and push.

success_criteria: The actual aspire agent init mechanism is determined by running it and observing real output/file changes, not assumed from documentation
At least one live aspire CLI command (describe/ps/logs/otel) is actually run against a running AppHost and its real output recorded
AppHost lifecycle in this verification uses aspire start/wait/stop, not dotnet run plus manual process killing
plugins/pmcro-aspire is corrected to match observed reality wherever it previously stated something that did not hold up
Corrected skill, its plugin.json version bump, and the newly-installed .agents/skills/aspire* files are committed and pushed
out_of_scope: Removing or replacing the Claude Code PostToolUse telemetry hook aspire agent init installed in ~/.claude/settings.json -- left as-is, just documented
name_rationale: Names both halves of this cycle: live verification, and the correction it forced.
